name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: 15 ly goes with exactly two of Eklund, Beacon, and Geode.
Cho's distance is lower than both the colonist in the Cortex module and the colonist studying Fungus.
Exactly one of these is true: Cho goes with 15 ly; Beacon goes with 13 ly; Geode goes with 13 ly.
Either Lichen goes with Cortex or Geode goes with 17 ly.
